scenes.text: Identify, explain and apply the important ideas behind ram and rom.
RAM: is temporary working memory used while programs run. ROM: stores instructions that normally remain when power is off.
Storage: keeps files for later use. Flash drive: is portable file storage. Hard drive: is a storage device used in many computers.
In a small group, draw or safely examine pictures of ram, rom and storage. Explain one real-life use for each in Ghana.
